title: VillagersB
description: Couple of quality-of-life features for villagers.
body:
VillagersB is a quality-of-life mod for stuff relating to villagers.

This mod makes starting a villager breeder easier and makes villagers generally less annoying.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/B4F1q5PtNoY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# Features

- This mod removes the timer for breeding for villagers, this will allow you to quickly start a villager breeder with only 2 villagers.

- You can carry villagers by pressing the “V” key. That way you don’t have to deal with boats and you don’t have to worry about villagers being attacked while you’re moving them. This will make starting a villager breeder faster too.

- You can convert “nitwit” villagers(villagers that don’t do any job) to normal villagers by giving them 1 emerald(drop the emerald on the ground, nitwit will pick it up).


There are also particle effects for carrying and converting villagers too.

In the future I want to add the ability to "re-roll" the stuff the villagers are selling, so that you can more easily get mending and various other items.

--- 

## Version / Dependencies

Currently, the mod is designed to work with:

- Java 25
- Minecraft version 26.1.1
- Fabric loader version 0.18.6
- Fabric_api version 0.145.3+26.1.1
